literal_meaning: মুখকে ফিরিয়ে নেওয়া (to turn away the face)
figurative_meaning_en: to be displeased or unfavorable, misfortune or bad luck
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ভাগ্য মুখ ফিরিয়েছে, কোনো কাজই সফল হচ্ছে না।
বন্ধুটি অসন্তুষ্ট হয়ে মুখ ফিরিয়ে চলে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His fortune has turned its face away; nothing is going right for him.
The friend turned away his face in displeasure and left.
note: Often used in contexts involving fate or personal rejection, reflecting Bengali fatalistic expressions.
